coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Six of nine ground-truth variable items match (67%): WikiText-2 evaluation at sequence length 2048, an unquantized 16-bit baseline, 4/3/2-bit weights, all four quantization methods, perplexity, and numerical-failure monitoring.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces LLAMA2-70B with LLaMA-3-8B and uses symmetric rather than asymmetric quantization, with optional group-wise granularity instead of fixed per-column quantization. Although weight-only quantization is specified, FP16/BF16 alternatives are allowed and KV-cache precision is not fixed explicitly to FP16. Additional datasets, benchmarks, and controls expand beyond the target experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the expected Table 7 results, QuaRot-GPTQ's low-bit improvements, RTN failures, limited QuaRot-RTN stabilization, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
